datasets.name: Bijie landslide detection data set
datasets.verbatim: First, satellite images (DB-1) (open-source): The Bijie (Guizhou province, China) landslide detection data set (Ji et al. 2020) is acquired by TripleSat with a spatial resolution of 0.8 meters (m).

datasets.name: UAV images (DB-2)
datasets.verbatim: Secondly, UAV images (DB-2) (Ullo et al. 2021): The data set consists of 281 images divided into set A (160) and set B (121). The images were downloaded from multiple search engines like Google and Bing. The UAV data set is available at https://github.com/amritamohan61/Landslide-data-and-code˙Mask-R-CNN.

methods.name: YOLOv5, YOLOv6, YOLOv7, and YOLOv8
methods.summary: The authors applied and evaluated the performance of different variants of YOLOv5, YOLOv6, YOLOv7, and YOLOv8 for extracting landslide information from satellite and UAV-based data. These single-staged object detection models combine classification and localization to detect landslides represented by bounding boxes.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, in this study, we applied and evaluated the performance of different variants of YOLOv5, YOLOv6, YOLOv7, and YOLOv8 for extracting landslide information from distinct data sources.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but lack direct links, and the custom code used for the YOLO variants is not provided or linked in the publication.
